name: Temperature Display Thermos Water Bottle 500ML Stainless Steel Insulated Hot and Cold Flask with LED Display (Random Colors)
description:
Stay hydrated in style with the Temperature Display Thermos Water Bottle. Made from high-quality stainless steel, this 500ML insulated bottle keeps your drinks hot or cold for up to 12 hours. Featuring a smart LED temperature display, anti-scald lid, and leakproof design, it’s perfect for daily use at the office, during travel, or outdoor activities. Safe, durable, and easy to clean, it’s a practical gift option for family and friends.
Key Features:
 Capacity: 500ML
 Material: Premium stainless steel with dual-wall insulation
 LED temperature display with touch sensor
 Retains hot or cold beverages for up to 12 hours
 BPA-free, leakproof silicone lid seal
 Fits most car cup holders and backpacks
How to Use:
 Fill the bottle with hot or cold beverage
 Close the lid securely to prevent leaks
 Touch the lid to check water temperature
 Carry easily for office, travel, or outdoor use
 Wash and dry thoroughly after each use
Safety Information:
 Do not microwave or freeze the bottle
 Avoid using carbonated or fermenting liquids
 Keep out of reach of children when filled with hot drinks
Package Includes:
 1 × 500ML Temperature Display Thermos Water Bottle (Random Color)
